description: This Java source file defines an abstract class 'ThriftCLIService' that implements a Thrift-based CLI service for Apache Hive. It manages server initialization, session handling, security, and communication with clients via Thrift protocols, including session management, command execution, and metadata retrieval.

classes.name: ThriftCLIServerContext
classes.description: Implements ServerContext to hold session handle information for each client connection.

methods.name: init
methods.description: Initializes server configuration, including host, port, and thread settings based on HiveConf and environment variables.

methods.name: start
methods.description: Starts the server thread and initializes server components if not already started.

methods.name: stop
methods.description: Stops the server thread and server components if running.

methods.name: getPortNumber
methods.description: Returns the port number the server is listening on.

methods.name: getServerIPAddress
methods.description: Returns the server's IP address.

methods.name: GetDelegationToken
methods.description: Returns a delegation token; not supported in this implementation.

methods.name: CancelDelegationToken
methods.description: Cancels a delegation token; not supported.

methods.name: RenewDelegationToken
methods.description: Renews a delegation token; not supported.

methods.name: OpenSession
methods.description: Handles opening a new client session, managing user identity, proxy, and protocol version.

methods.name: SetClientInfo
methods.description: Logs client configuration info; currently a placeholder.

methods.name: CloseSession
methods.description: Closes an existing client session.

methods.name: GetInfo
methods.description: Retrieves information about the server or session.

methods.name: ExecuteStatement
methods.description: Executes a SQL statement asynchronously or synchronously.

methods.name: GetTypeInfo
methods.description: Retrieves type information.

methods.name: GetCatalogs
methods.description: Retrieves catalog information.

methods.name: GetSchemas
methods.description: Retrieves schema information.

methods.name: GetTables
methods.description: Retrieves table metadata.

methods.name: GetTableTypes
methods.description: Retrieves table type information.

methods.name: GetColumns
methods.description: Retrieves column metadata.

methods.name: GetFunctions
methods.description: Retrieves function metadata.

methods.name: GetOperationStatus
methods.description: Checks the status of a running operation.

methods.name: CancelOperation
methods.description: Cancels an ongoing operation.

methods.name: CloseOperation
methods.description: Closes an operation handle.

methods.name: GetResultSetMetadata
methods.description: Retrieves metadata for a result set.

methods.name: FetchResults
methods.description: Fetches query results.

methods.name: GetPrimaryKeys
methods.description: Retrieves primary key info for a table.

methods.name: GetCrossReference
methods.description: Retrieves cross-reference info between tables.

methods.name: GetQueryId
methods.description: Retrieves the query ID for an operation.

methods.name: UploadData
methods.description: Placeholder for upload data; not implemented.

methods.name: DownloadData
methods.description: Placeholder for download data; not implemented.

methods.name: run
methods.description: Abstract method to run the server; to be implemented by subclasses.

methods.name: getProxyUser
methods.description: Determines the effective user for proxying, with privilege checks.

methods.name: isKerberosAuthMode
methods.description: Checks if the current authentication mode is Kerberos.
